definitions.explanation: A state of physical weakness and decline, often due to illness, old age, or malnutrition. Describes a serious deterioration of bodily strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{衰弱|すいじゃく}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{衰弱|すいじゃく}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: His body became debilitated from a long hospital stay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{救助|きゅうじょ}→救助：02588_kyuujo⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{登山者|とざんしゃ}→登山者：21318_tozansha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{衰弱|すいじゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{搬送|はんそう}→搬送：24543_hansou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The rescued climber was severely weakened and was immediately transported to the hospital.

notes:
USAGE:
Often appears in news reports about rescued persons or patients in serious condition. The compound {衰弱|すいじゃく}⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧ (death from debilitation/exhaustion) is used when someone dies from neglect or prolonged weakness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {衰弱|すいじゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become debilitated
- {衰弱|すいじゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧: severely weakened
- {衰弱|すいじゃく}⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧: death from debilitation
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{衰弱|すいじゃく}: decline in physical strength
